item.title: Mikimoto Pearl Island: Birthplace of the Cultured Pearl — Guide
item.description: Mikimoto Pearl Island, a small islet linked by bridge to central Toba, is where the modern pearl was born: here in 1893 Kokichi Mikimoto succeeded in culturing the world’s first spherical pearl, founding an industry and a global brand. The island’s museum traces how cultured pearls are made and graded, displays dazzling pearl artworks — including a pagoda and crown set with thousands of pearls — and, most memorably, stages live demonstrations by white-clad ama, the traditional women free-divers who once harvested the pearl oysters.
